nb-good-seasons.label: Seasons SRH conceded less than the league in the first three overs
nb-good-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
nb-good-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (1) THEN (d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (1) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) team, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (1) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 2 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year

nb-l0.label: Bowling side's IPL win rate with no wicket in overs 1–3
nb-l0.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
nb-l0.query: WITH w AS (SELECT i.innings_id, i.match_id, i.bowling_team_id bo, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM innings i JOIN deliveries d ON d.innings_id = i.innings_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 2 GROUP BY i.innings_id) SELECT CASE WHEN wk >= 2 THEN '2+' ELSE CAST(wk AS TEXT) END k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id = w.bo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won, SUM(CASE WHEN w.bo IN (1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tn, SUM(CASE WHEN w.bo IN (1) AND m.winner_id = w.bo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tw FROM w JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = w.match_id WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY k ORDER BY k
